datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators conducted regular (typically monthly) surveys to classify acute food insecurity conditions using the IPC framework. Geographic data representing IPC classifications were compiled for medium-term projections at four time points in 2013 (January, April, July, October) and distributed as GeoJSON files.
